_readme: Every content photo slot in the theme. pt_image( 'slot' ) renders these. A slot with file:null renders a correctly-sized grey placeholder, so swapping in a real photo causes zero layout shift and needs no template or CSS change. 'file' is a filename in assets/images/src/. 'option' names a Customizer setting holding a Media Library attachment ID, which wins over 'file' when set.
